name: research-task-system
description: Shared-context research workflows with MATLAB-first computation, fingerprinted lifecycle state, validated evidence, and researcher-reviewed SciencePlots figures.

interface.longDescription: Author and revise current-action TODOs, execute MATLAB-first work/right/fast stages in one shared context, validate aggregate evidence, prepare resumable long-run scripts, and produce researcher-reviewed figures from separate SciencePlots Python scripts.
defaultPrompt: Use Research Task System to author current-action-only TODO specifications from this research material.
Use Research Task System to initialize todo_ready, resolve bounded project and data questions, and present every eligible rule including self.
Use Research Task System to execute the recorded state with MATLAB-first computation, representative performance benchmarks, validated aggregates, and separate SciencePlots Python figure scripts.
